verdict.rationale: Segment's docs list official tracking libraries for C#, Java, JavaScript, Kotlin (Android) and Swift, show an analytics.track code sample, and the Public API reference includes an 'Install and use an SDK' section with a downloadable OpenAPI spec. The evidence only names these SDKs and does not document their depth, installation, versioning or developer experience, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: detailed per-SDK documentation (install, configuration, method reference), evidence of SDK maintenance and versioning, hands-on or independent corroboration of the SDKs in use.
